note: o_hat fake-quantize sim, W8A8 MoDiff, batch 128, 50 DDIM, seed 1234, MODIFF_AHAT_BLOCK=32 (so a_hat is ALSO 8-bit B=32 in every row -- these are combined numbers). MODIFF_OHAT_SIM_BLOCK=32 along K. image MSE vs the fp16-o_hat reference; the floor row is a second fp16-o_hat process at the same seed. peak memory in the sim is meaningless (fp32 temps).

block_sweep_8bit_SR.note: 8 bit + stochastic rounding, block along K varied. -1 = one scale per pixel over all K. Granularity is nearly irrelevant: 32 -> per-pixel (6-48x coarser) moves image MSE from 1.71x to 2.26x of the floor, all indistinguishable. B=128 reads BETTER than B=32, which is noise -- the whole range is inside run-to-run variation.

implementation_prices.note: CUTLASS 4.6.1 EVT nodes are AccFetch/AuxLoad/AuxStore/Col+RowBroadcast/Col+RowReduction/Compute/ScalarBroadcast/ScalarReduction -- no blocked broadcast and no blocked reduction, and the visitor model is single-pass while a block amax must complete BEFORE the scaled store. Finer blocks are EASIER, not harder: B=32 fits inside one CTA's N tile while a per-pixel all-K amax spans CTAs.

kernel.note: conv2d_int8_evt_o_hat_q8 / _q8r in csrc/modiff/conv/conv2d_evt.cu. All native CUTLASS EVT nodes: AuxLoad<int8> * RowBroadcast(s_read) + acc*alpha*weight_scale, * RowBroadcast(1/s_write), AuxStore<int8>. float->int8 goes through cvt.rni.sat.s8.f32 which SATURATES, so no clamp nodes. _q8r adds VisitorRowReduction<AbsMaxReduce, atomic_maximum> so step t writes the per-channel amax step t+1 needs -- self-contained, no calibration table.
kernel.correctness: codes bit-exact vs an fp32 torch reference on 5 shapes (mismatch 0, max|dcode| 0); _q8r identical to _q8; amax output correct to 1.2e-07 relative.
